segments.title: 第13章 巨大驚喜
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 13: A Huge Surprise

Very, very, very good?

What level was a score like that?

Could it be much higher than the general high school admission cutoff?

With anticipation and doubt, Lin Xiuhong opened her eyes and looked at the phone screen.

When she saw the ridiculously high scores for each subject, and the final total of 555, she was instantly stunned.

Her mind buzzed, as if the world was spinning, and everything went blank.

Then, an immense surprise, like fireworks blooming in the sky, exploded again and again in Lin Xiuhong's mind.

Meanwhile, Li Guohong, standing by her side, was behind Li Luo and couldn't see the phone screen clearly due to his poor eyesight.

But he had to maintain a father's composure, so he could only ask with inward anxiety and outward calm, "So? Did he do well? Did he make the cutoff for general high school?"

"He didn't just make the cutoff," Zhao Rongjun was half-leaning over the counter, looking at the scores on the phone upside down. His mouth hung wide open as he couldn't help but say, "With this score, Li Luo could get into Number One Affiliated High with plenty to spare."

"Huh?" Li Guohong's expression froze when he heard Zhao Rongjun. He thought he had misheard. "Xiao Jun, what did you say? Number One Affiliated High? Are you sure?"

As he said this, Li Guohong pulled Li Luo out of the way, all his feigned calm and composure thrown to the wind. He leaned right in front of the phone and meticulously read the scores on it.

"Five hundred fifty-five… Five hundred fifty-five… Five hundred fifty-five…"

Li Guohong muttered to himself, then abruptly turned his head to look at his wife, asking nervously and excitedly, "Xiuhong, do you remember what scores Li Luo used to get on his exams? I can't quite recall."

"He used to only get around four hundred! When did he ever score so high!" Lin Xiuhong scolded and laughed at the same time, snatching the phone from Li Guohong's hand and then grabbing the exam admission ticket from Li Luo. "Let me see if there's been a mistake."

Saying that, she compared the number on the admission ticket with the one sent in the text message over and over again, finally confirming that this was her son's actual score.

Beside them, Ying Chanxi also looked at the score on the phone, then her gaze fell on the composed Li Luo.

Noticing his childhood friend's gaze, which was a mixture of joy and confusion, Li Luo coughed twice and said with a smile, "I have to thank you for helping me review. Otherwise, I couldn't have gotten such a high score."

"Yes, yes, yes! We must thank Xixi!" Lin Xiuhong reacted at that moment, holding Ying Chanxi's hand and thanking her repeatedly. She didn't forget to instruct Li Guohong, "We're closing for lunch! Let's cook a good meal ourselves!"

"Okay!" Li Guohong agreed readily with a big smile on his face. "We have plenty of ingredients in the shop. I'll go to the market later to buy some more. We'll make a full table of food! To thank Xixi properly."

"Well…" Ying Chanxi felt a bit undeserving seeing the sincere gratitude on their faces. She waved her hands and explained, "Actually, it wasn't my doing."

"Uncle and Auntie, you don't know, but Li Luo asked Zhao Rongjun to help him review a long time ago. The little bit of help I gave him during the two days of the high school entrance exam was just the icing on the cake."

"If helping someone review for two days could raise their score from the four-hundreds to 555, I could apply for the 'Outstanding Teacher' award at school."

"So, if you want to thank someone, the person you should really thank is Zhao Rongjun."

Upon hearing this, both Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were taken aback.

They looked at Li Luo, then at Zhao Rongjun, and slowly began to understand.

No wonder this kid Li Luo had been so confident after the exams, insisting he could get into Number One Affiliated High. It turned out he had a plan all along!

"You brat…" Lin Xiuhong looked at Li Luo, feeling a mix of anger, exasperation, and happiness. The complicated emotions all jumbled together left her at a loss for words.

Li Guohong, however, couldn't resist reaching out a large hand, pressing down on Li Luo's head and rubbing it vigorously as he laughed heartily, "Good, good, good! You were planning to surprise your mom and dad, weren't you? You hid it so well."

Then, Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong's gazes turned to Zhao Rongjun, and they asked gently and kindly, "Xiao Jun, what would you like to eat? You name it, Uncle and Auntie will treat you to a feast for lunch today!"

"Uh, this…" Zhao Rongjun was a bit bewildered by their successive waves of attention. He thought to himself, did Li Luo dragging him out to play basketball every day count as helping him review?

How come he didn't know about it himself?

But thinking back to the question Ying Chanxi had asked him before, Zhao Rongjun began to put two and two together.

Could it be that Li Luo secretly found a place to study hard after every basketball session with him?

At this thought, Zhao Rongjun looked at Li Luo with suspicion.

Seeing the calm and unconcerned expression on his face, Zhao Rongjun's heart skipped a beat, and a certain respect began to grow within him.

Who would have thought, who would have thought, that you were the one hiding the deepest!

"Uncle, Auntie," Zhao Rongjun's expression turned serious. He felt that Li Luo's quiet efforts behind the scenes shouldn't go unrecognized, so he said, "Actually, this is all the result of Li Luo's own hard work. It has nothing to do with me."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo had already walked over to Zhao Rongjun's side and grabbed him by the shoulder. "Stop being so modest. Hurry up and say what you want to eat."

"I remember you like eel, right? And pig's ear?"

"I'll have my dad make them all for you!"

"Okay, I've got it," Li Guohong said, patting his chest with a smile. "You all sit down and rest. Your auntie and I will go to the market to buy some groceries."

Zhao Rongjun watched with a dazed expression as the couple walked out of the shop. He then turned to Li Luo, somewhat speechless.

But since Ying Chanxi was still here, and seeing that Li Luo didn't want to make a big deal out of it, Zhao Rongjun kept his mouth shut. He would just let it be that he had tutored Li Luo.

After sending off the last wave of customers, Li Luo hung a "Temporarily Closed" sign on the door, then picked up a cloth and began tidying up the shop.

Seeing Li Luo so busy, Zhao Rongjun felt a bit embarrassed and stood up to help.

"You're the man of the hour. If my parents come back and see you helping, they'll nag me to death." Li Luo rolled his eyes and pushed him back down. Then he tossed a cloth to Ying Chanxi. "You want to?"

"So I'm not the woman of the hour?" Ying Chanxi huffed in mock annoyance, but still picked up the cloth and helped wipe down a table.

She was in a particularly good mood today, so she didn't bother bickering with Li Luo. She was even humming happily as she worked.

"By the way," Zhao Rongjun sat there, took out his phone to check the class's QQ group, and couldn't help asking, "Don't you want to say something in the group? I see everyone is sharing their scores."

"There's nothing much to say about it," Li Luo shook his head. "Isn't there a graduation ceremony this afternoon? They'll find out eventually."

"Didn't someone just say they wanted to show off?" Ying Chanxi glanced at him sideways. "With your score, you're probably the highest in our class, right?"

"Calm, calm." Li Luo raised a hand to gesture for her to settle down, chuckling, "It's precisely at times like these that one must maintain one's composure. Otherwise, you'll look like the nouveau riche, wealthy but without class."

"Speak human."

"It's more satisfying to show off in person."

…

At noon, Li Guohong spent over an hour busy in the breakfast shop's back kitchen, preparing a full table of dishes, all of which were the three kids' favorites.

Both husband and wife were all smiles, seemingly happier than they had ever been.

Although it wasn't the college entrance exam results, if Li Luo could get into Number One Affiliated High, with its over 90% university admission rate in previous years, it could be said that Li Luo already had one foot in the door to a bachelor's degree.

This was such a joyous occasion that Lin Xiuhong even took the initiative to bring out a bottle of baijiu for Li Guohong, and filled a glass for him.

"You can drink as much as you want today. I won't stop you," Lin Xiuhong said, even pouring a small glass for herself.

Then she brought over a large bottle of fruit juice and poured some for all three youngsters.

"Come," Li Guohong rose to his feet, raising his glass and saying with a grin, "Li Luo, and our two little heroes, let's celebrate."

Lin Xiuhong also stood up smiling, raising her glass and saying, "You'll all be classmates at the same school in the future. You should interact more often and have Li Luo learn from you."

"You're too kind, Uncle and Auntie," Zhao Rongjun knew he didn't deserve the credit and quickly stood up, raising his glass in response.

Ying Chanxi, beside him, also stood up with a faint smile, happily clinking glasses with them. Then she pulled Li Luo up to his feet and toasted him, "Congratulations on getting into Number One Affiliated High, Li Luo~"

Looking at the lively scene before him, Li Luo raised his glass and drank it all in one gulp. His heroic manner made one think he was drinking alcohol.

Li Luo savored the taste of the juice in his mouth and felt it was still not quite right. So he said to his dad, "Dad, give me a glass too."

"A glass of what." Lin Xiuhong slapped away his outstretched hand and said peevishly, "Minors are not allowed to drink. Go drink your juice."

Li Luo, who had been getting a bit carried away, was slapped back to reality by his mom, remembering that he was still a minor.

"Alright, alright," Li Guohong said with a laugh. "Let's eat, or the food will get cold."

Although he had always run a breakfast shop, Li Guohong's culinary skills were at a chef's level, and he cooked a great meal.

Especially since it was stir-fried in the shop's large wok, the dishes had an enticing "wok hei" aroma the moment they were served. Li Luo and the others ate with great relish.

During the meal, Lin Xiuhong asked, "What was the cutoff score for Number One Affiliated High last year?"

"Last year it was 507," Ying Chanxi blurted out instinctively, then added, "Auntie Lin, don't worry. Li Luo's rank in this year's high school entrance exam is 86th in the entire district. He's 100% getting into Number One Affiliated High. No need to worry about the cutoff score."

"That's right," Zhao Rongjun also nodded. "Excluding those of us admitted through independent recruitment, Number One Affiliated High will still enroll over four hundred new students. Li Luo's rank is definitely a sure thing."

After confirming once more that her son could really get into Number One Affiliated High, Lin Xiuhong's heart felt even more at ease. She even ate an extra bowl of rice.

After they finished eating, Li Luo said to his parents, "We're going to school this afternoon for the graduation ceremony. We'll have dinner with our classmates, so we won't be back to eat."

"Got it, go ahead," Lin Xiuhong replied, then said, "Do you have enough money? Do you have to pay for the dinner gathering?"

"Didn't you already give me some?" Li Luo waved his hand. "Don't worry about it. We're leaving now."

Watching the kids leave the shop, Lin Xiuhong's face broke into a gratified smile.

She leaned against the doorframe, the breeze lifting the stray hairs by her ear. She let out a soft sigh, feeling as if an invisible heavy burden had been temporarily lifted from her shoulders. She felt light, almost floaty.

Her son's high school entrance exam results felt so unreal, like she was in a dream.

"What's wrong? They've gone to school, right?" After cleaning up the kitchen, Li Guohong walked to the door and looked out, then wrapped his arm around his wife and smiled, "Happy now, aren't you?"

"Get off me, we're on the street. What are you doing, hugging me?" Lin Xiuhong gave him a push, but not forcefully. After a symbolic struggle, she leaned into her husband's embrace.

"I'm happy, what's wrong with a hug?" Li Guohong hugged her tightly a few times. The two of them stood there, soothing their excited and joyful hearts from the day.

After Lin Xiuhong had calmed down, she half-leaned in Li Guohong's arms and suddenly said, "Old Li."

"Hm?"

"That apartment your youngest uncle's family has…"

"Buy it!"

"Mhm... That's what I was thinking too."

The couple looked at each other and smiled, their minds already made up.
